nodes.name: history_commands.rs
nodes.summary: Exposes a wide family of Tauri commands — one set per supported external CLI tool (Cursor, Codex, Claude Code, Windsurf, Cline, Warp, and more) — for fetching chunked chat history, recent paths, and import stats; the widest single command surface in the batch (808 lines, 45 exports).
nodes.languageNotes: Highly repetitive per-tool command triplets (history_chunks / recent_paths / history_stat) generated by hand for each supported external CLI source.

nodes.name: projected_rounds_to_cached_turns
nodes.summary: Converts projected conversation rounds into the cached-turn representation used by the history UI.

nodes.name: orgtrack_session_turn_metadata_index
nodes.summary: Tauri command returning a metadata index for the requested turn IDs of a session.

nodes.name: imported_recent_paths
nodes.summary: Lists recently modified imported-history file paths across all external CLI sources.

nodes.name: external_history_rescan_source
nodes.summary: Tauri command that rescans (and optionally clears) a single external CLI source's imported history.

nodes.name: external_history_rescan_sources
nodes.summary: Tauri command that rescans (and optionally clears) imported history for multiple external CLI sources.
